(b) If $a$ and $b$ are elements of $S$, then $a+b$ is an element of $S$. (We allow $a$ and $b$ to be the same.) Find all possibilities for the set $S$ (with proof).

mmaths-2019-tiebreaker-03.prompt: Let $m$ and $n$ be positive integers. Find (with proof) the number of ways for Alice and Bob to get to their destinations if their paths never pass through the same point (even at different times).
